args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Error-kind toasts should use an assertive live region (e.g. aria-live="assertive"/role="alert") and should not be auto-dismissed by the setTimeout in the Toast component; only non-error toasts should auto-dismiss after AUTO_DISMISS_MS, while errors stay until the user clicks the dismiss button.

label: bug
file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.
In src/components/Toast.tsx the single toast-stack container is hardcoded with role="status" aria-live="polite" for all toast kinds, and the Toast component's useEffect always sets a setTimeout(() => onDismiss(item.id), AUTO_DISMISS_MS) regardless of item.kind, so error toasts are announced politely and vanish after five seconds just like success/info toasts.
